_comment: BEIR runs only (dev_tools/eval/beir/bench.py). A BEIR corpus has no authority table, so the shipped `balanced` (authority 0.5) is refused at startup, correctly. Here `balanced` is the shipped weights with authority removed: the structural and topical priors the generic profile does declare, behind the same relevance floor. `literal` is unchanged: no prior at all. Neither is fitted on BEIR.

balanced.description: Shipped `balanced` without the authority term (no authority table in a BEIR corpus).

literal.description: No metadata prior: the arms' own fused order.
